files_NOT_held.why_it_matters: THE BLOCKER FOR THIS CURATION. The 20 amine head groups are referenced in the SI only as the integers 1-20; the SI names only amine 1 and draws no amine panel. Without the main article's amine figure, 9 of the 12 valued lipidoids in Table S3 have a measured value and no structure. The main article also holds the cell line, the reporter gene and the assay timepoint, none of which appear in the SI.
